capabilities.name: Project relationship and provenance graph
capabilities.description: Represent documents, sections, ranges, cells, charts, symbols, files, models, materials, scenes, shots, clips, game entities, simulations, workflows, extensions, and outputs as linkable project resources.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.1 Project relationship and provenance graph
capabilities.notes: Tracks stable IDs, versions, ownership, dependencies, provenance, permissions, stale links, missing references, and source or derived state.

capabilities.name: Cross-platform relationship queries and navigation
capabilities.description: Provide relationship graph queries and bidirectional navigation through slice UI, Command Center, CLI, workflows, extensions, AI, and collaboration surfaces.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.1 Project relationship and provenance graph
capabilities.notes: Cycle and destructive-update detection is part of graph navigation and analysis.

capabilities.name: Link embed snapshot and representation framework
capabilities.description: Support linked, embedded, snapshot, generated, cached, and fallback representations of project resources.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.2 Link embed snapshot refresh and conflict framework

capabilities.name: Controlled refresh and update policies
capabilities.description: Provide refresh previews, affected-resource lists, update policies, approved auto-refresh boundaries, source navigation, and downstream-edit preservation warnings.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.2 Link embed snapshot refresh and conflict framework
capabilities.notes: Cross-slice changes must never silently destroy source data or downstream edits.

capabilities.name: Cross-slice link repair and conflict handling
capabilities.description: Detect and repair moved, renamed, missing, stale, conflicting, or incompatible relationship sources.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.2 Link embed snapshot refresh and conflict framework

capabilities.name: Cross-slice reporting and research workflows
capabilities.description: Provide live tables, charts, ranges, API documentation, design reports, BOMs, shot lists, schedules, build reports, experiment reports, dashboards, and scientific result links.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.3 Docs Sheets reporting and research workflows
capabilities.notes: Scientific plots, units, parameters, provenance, and validation metadata must survive linking and export.

capabilities.name: Creative slice handoff framework
capabilities.description: Provide controlled code-symbol, shader, model-to-animation, model-to-game, animation-to-game, cinematic, data-table, diagnostic, and asset-update handoffs.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.4 Code Modeling Animation and Game handoffs
capabilities.notes: Update policies include hierarchy, transform, materials, rigs, animation, colliders, units, naming, and prefabs.

capabilities.name: Unified project and creator workflow templates
capabilities.description: Provide reusable all-slice project templates and creator workflow templates with status, logs, dry runs, cancellation, validation, and recovery.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.5 Unified workflows templates tasks and command-center integration
capabilities.notes: Relationships are prepared for later AI, marketplace packs, cloud synchronization, and collaboration.

capabilities.name: Unified project relationship health
capabilities.description: Surface stale dependencies, blocked tasks, jobs, builds, renders, simulations, extension conflicts, queues, and relationship health through Command Center.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.5 Unified workflows templates tasks and command-center integration

capabilities.name: Multi-resource transaction recovery
capabilities.description: Snapshot related resources before batch updates and restore a consistent project state after partial cross-slice failures.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.6 Cross-slice recovery and all-suite reference project
capabilities.notes: Project migration and rollback must operate across the complete relationship graph.

capabilities.name: All-suite reference project
capabilities.description: Maintain a reference project that exercises Docs, Sheets, Code, Modeling, Animation, Game, simulations, workflows, extensions, CLI, Command Center, and shared engines together.
capabilities.source: v1.15 — Wave 1.15.6 Cross-slice recovery and all-suite reference project
capabilities.notes: The reference project validates end-to-end links, migration, rollback, compatibility, and update policies.
